author: Many_Excitement4023
title: Diablo 2 taught me about the nature of humanity, at a very young age.
body: I remember I was about 11 years old then. Naive to scammers, and the lot of that. I still remember the very first time I got scammed, this fellow waited for me to die, dropped a ton of  items on my body, then I picked up those items which equipped, and because of that didn't have room for my good gear which dropped on the ground. Though it is interesting because, I could have learned that same lesson in real life in a much worse way. That sort of sheds a positive light on it.
